verdict.rationale: Quo's own marketing says recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, and its MCP docs reference call transcripts alongside conversations, so the core AI transcript and summary capability is first-party. The evidence never explicitly says these artifacts are attached to the conversation thread, and all of it is vendor marketing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that summaries and transcripts attach to the conversation thread, in-depth feature docs (plan availability, recording requirements), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, calls get AI summaries and transcripts attached to the conversation

citations.quote: Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
